But HCF takes two numbers. Maybe they mean compute HCF of the result with each of the numbers in the second pair? Or compute HCF of the result and the pair (90,120) meaning HCF of result and HCF of (90,120)? The phrasing ambiguous. Let's interpret: After computing HCF(45,60)=15. Then use that result to find HCF with another pair (90,120). Likely they want HCF(15,90,120). But HCF function only takes two numbers. Could compute HCF(15,90)=15, then HCF(15,120)=15. So result remains 15. Alternatively compute HCF(15, HCF(90,120)). HCF(90,120)=30. Then HCF(15,30)=15. So same.

Thus final answer: HCF(45,60)=15; HCF(15,90,120)=15; HCF(36,48)=12; HCF(12,72,96)=12.
